worldcombat.skill.airslash.summary: Throw a straight blade of compressed air that slices through foes in a line and can cut airborne targets; those swept by the blade may flinch. Razor form flies faster and pierces one more target but is narrower and lighter; wide-gust form has a wider, heavier blade.
worldcombat.skill.airslash.use.0: Slice a row of lined-up foes along one straight line
worldcombat.skill.airslash.use.1: Open from range and force foes to move during the wind-up
worldcombat.skill.airslash.use.2: Cut airborne targets down with the wind blade
worldcombat.skill.airslash.description.0: The blade deals %1$s special damage with a %2$s-block body.
worldcombat.skill.airslash.description.1: It travels up to %1$s blocks (%2$s blocks per tick) and pierces up to %3$s extra target(s) in a line.
worldcombat.skill.airslash.description.2: A struck target has a %1$s chance to flinch for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.airslash.description.3: It stirs about %1$s shards of cut air; razor form is currently %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.airslash.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.airslash.growth.0: From level %1$s the blade rises to %2$s and the travel to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.airslash.preference.ra: On: faster flight, one more pierced target and slightly longer range, but a narrower, lighter blade, shakier flinch and longer cooldown — for picking off a row of frail foes. Off (wide-gust form, default): wider, heavier blade with a steadier flinch, but slower flight and one fewer pierce.
worldcombat.skill.airslash.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values open with a cut from farther away, where a foe can still walk out of the wind-up.
